source_identity.source_title: Pyrodiversity of boreal lake islands begets biodiversity of beetles, plants, and birds

study_system.region: Lac la Ronge region, northern Saskatchewan, Canada
study_system.standardized_plot: one 30 x 30 m plot per island, at least 15 m from shoreline

endpoint_scope.primary_reason: largest prospectively known complete 42-island binary community matrix (466 species), chosen for support rather than observed effect direction
endpoint_scope.target_one: species detected in the standardized island sampling assemblage
endpoint_scope.target_zero: species not detected in the standardized island sampling assemblage
endpoint_scope.endpoint_interpretation: observed local insular assemblage occurrence under standardized sampling, not complete whole-island occupancy

secondary_taxa.role: directional secondary replication under the identical frozen island split

secondary_taxa.known_missing_response: island BS contains empty plant cells because it burned before vascular-plant survey
secondary_taxa.role: secondary replication with response-quality missingness handled prospectively

v0_55_binding.primary_question: Does species-conditioned internal occupied-source continuity improve heldout beetle occurrence prediction beyond fire/history/habitat, external isolation, generic island geometry, global occupancy breadth and direct/diffuse source proximity?
v0_55_binding.external_isolation: buffer5000, with source documentation defining 1 as no land within the 5-km buffer and therefore stronger isolation
v0_55_binding.internal_source_isolation: training-only species-conditioned occupied-source geometry among the 42 island sampling sites

R0: prospectively_allowlisted local habitat structure variables that are complete enough to use without post-response imputation
R1_add: taxon-relevant surrounding habitat amount where complete
R2_add: response-independent generic spatial/network context from frozen Lat/Long
C_add: training-only species-conditioned multi-hop/internal source continuity not reducible to R3
reference_template.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and frozen spatial-cluster bootstrap 95% upper confidence limit < 0

geometry_and_partition_template.graph_radii: q25/q50/q75/q90 of nearest-neighbour distances, rounded upward under a frozen deterministic rule
geometry_and_partition_template.spatial_blocks: connected components at the coarsest frozen radius retaining enough independent target-populated blocks
geometry_and_partition_template.split: deterministic SHA-ranked 20% pilot / 80% confirmatory by frozen spatial block
geometry_and_partition_template.if_no_geometry_support: STOP_before_response; no administrative fallback chosen after inspecting outcomes

fixed_species_rule_template.primary_beetles: after pilot access only, include species observed on at least two distinct pilot islands; use the same fixed species universe for every heldout island
fixed_species_rule_template.reason: preserve v0.32 complement arithmetic and avoid heldout-specific species selection

dispersal_mode.design: compare taxon-specific source-pool increments across birds, beetles and plants only after each taxon's own frozen estimability gate
dispersal_mode.interpretation: higher mobility may increase the relevance of present internal source context

known_claim_boundaries: fixed-area plot occurrence is not complete whole-island occupancy
cross-sectional occurrence cannot identify contemporary colonization, extinction, or rescue
fire history/habitat must be represented in the reference before source-pool interpretation
the primary beetle endpoint cannot be replaced by birds or plants after seeing outcomes
next_action: schema-open only the frozen safe/mixed metadata files needed for island geometry, fire history and habitat reference; do not open beetle/bird/plant matrices; if public transport cannot deliver safe files, remain HOLD rather than using response or outcome-derived substitutes
